item.title: LADYGUNN – CHARLOTTE SANDS ON “SATELLITE”: SELF-TRUST, EXPERIMENTATION, AND A NEW CHAPTER
item.description: Charlotte Sands discusses her new album “Satellite,” creative freedom, genre fluidity, and the lessons learned after years of touring. In this LADYGUNN interview, the Nashville-born rock artist reflects on confidence, songwriting, and finding inspiration in a new chapter in Los Angeles.

item.title: LADYGUNN – FRIQTAO'S "LIFESTREAM 2", THE INTERNET'S FAVORITE PIANIST IS JUST GETTING STARTED
item.description: friqtao returns with “Lifestream 2,” a new piano EP that moves from the gentle melodies of “Raindrops” to the urgency of “SOS” and the reflective closing track “fristyle.” The viral TikTok pianist blends classical emotion with modern influences in a release that highlights his evolving musical voice.

item.title: LADYGUNN – FEMMECORE UNLEASHED: LITTLE MISS NASTY IS REWRITING THE RULES OF THE STAGE
item.description: Little Miss Nasty brings Femmecore worldwide with an international cast, creating high-energy performances that blend dance, music, and bold visuals.

item.title: LADYGUNN – JAMIE FINE ON THE LOST ART OF SITTING DOWN WITH SOMEONE YOU LOVE
item.description: Jamie Fine talks about her song “Cups of Coffee,” heartbreak, queer identity, and her first U.S. headlining tour in this intimate conversation with LADYGUNN.

item.title: DAVID GRIDLEY ON THE ART OF THE SITCOM
item.description: Actor and Scrubs newcomer discusses his character on the highly anticipated medical sitcom reboot, the history of sitcoms and what it is like to be a working after of over a decade.

item.title: LADYGUNN – DRUCKER LETS THE NIGHT STRETCH ON IN "MIND IN THE GUTTER"
item.description: Montreal artist Drucker returns with “Mind in the Gutter,” a powerful new single exploring heartbreak, regret, and emotional fallout ahead of his debut EP. Drucker delivers a haunting track paired with a striking video inspired by the atmosphere of the Chelsea Hotel.

item.title: LADYGUNN – PAWPAW ROD SUITS UP AND BETS ON HIMSELF
item.description: PawPaw Rod shares "Bettin On Me" from debut LP “Picture Day.” The Billy Lemos-produced track finds the genre-bending artist in a tiger mascot suit, delivering a daily affirmation on self-belief.
